mapper.select: SELECT s.station_id AS stationId, s.station_name AS stationName, s.lng, s.lat, COUNT(sp.id) AS parkingCount FROM route_station rs INNER JOIN station s ON rs.station_id = s.station_id LEFT JOIN station_parking sp ON s.station_id = sp.station_id WHERE rs.route_id = #{routeId} GROUP BY s.station_id, s.station_name, s.lng, s.lat, rs.id ORDER BY rs.id

SELECT DISTINCT r.route_id AS routeId, r.route_name AS routeName, r.is_up_or_down AS isUpOrDown FROM station s INNER JOIN route_station rs ON s.station_id = rs.station_id INNER JOIN route r ON rs.route_id = r.route_id WHERE s.cluster_id = #{clusterId} AND s.station_id > 10000 ORDER BY r.route_name, r.is_up_or_down
